spec_match.rationale: Exercises the three normative handshake outcomes with real response headers served by this site's own routes: Connection-Allowlist at-least-as-strict opt-in, Allow-Connection-Allowlist-From delegation, and the must-block no-header case.

interactive.rationale: A renavigate button reruns all three real frame navigations under the requirement; per-frame states update from genuine load/postMessage evidence with a 4-second no-report timeout standing in for the refused state.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises exactly these three frames and live outcomes; the page delivers them with the served header printed on each card.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers the all-load inert-attribute baseline, the sent-but-not-enforced pattern, the correct single-blocked pattern, and unexpected blocked-sets, each with its own verdict text.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5657801797009408 and the explainer's opt-in rules; code-path section shows the exact header lines.

conformance.rationale: The suite's optin/allow-from/blocked assertions are manual-kind records pointing at this page — honest for header contracts that page script cannot observe synchronously.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): initial auto-run plus a button re-run; all three frames LOADED with required-header-absent reports and working same-origin fetch probes; verdict took the honest inert-attribute branch; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the frame-3-refused pattern needs an origin-trial build.

telemetry_health.rationale: caee-handshake-honest-baseline asserts the three-report case; caee-handshake-block-pattern asserts the only-correct-blocked-set when timeouts occur; runId guards stale timeouts.

design_system.rationale: Frame-card states use blue/rose on bg-stone at AA and always pair color with LOADED/NO REPORT wording.

accessibility.rationale: Each iframe has a descriptive title, states are text elements adjacent to their frames, the verdict is aria-live=polite, and the renavigate button is a native 44px control.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read; cards stack via auto-fit minmax(260px).

openQuestions.title: Verify the refused frame on an origin-trial build
openQuestions.detail: On an enforcing build, confirm frames 1 and 2 load with the requirement reported, frame 3 shows NO REPORT with the console block message, and the caee-handshake-block-pattern assertion passes with blockedIds === ['noheader'].

guidanceConsulted.query: embedded content policy enforcement opt-in headers
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Make enforcement outcomes observable from real policy delivery rather than simulated states; blocked and loaded must be visually and programmatically distinct.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All outcomes derive from real navigations against routes serving the real headers; the blocked state is a distinct labelled text state fed by the absence of a genuine frame report.

guidanceConsulted.query: status updates for multiple async frames accessible
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: One polite live region for the aggregate outcome; per-item status as adjacent text, not color alone.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The aggregate verdict is the single aria-live region; per-frame states are text labels that include the words LOADED / NO REPORT.

summary: Three-way opt-in handshake against live routes serving Connection-Allowlist, Allow-Connection-Allowlist-From and no headers. Verified on headless Chromium 141 incl. experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): all frames loaded with header-absent reports (honest inert baseline), clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
